audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagreed with the whys beside them. Rows 0-3 were all given to Lucian while their whys read 'even farm start', 'favors you', 'stays yours' and 'a skill-check'; row 5 read Skill under a why saying your durability wins all-ins; row 6 read Zaahen under a why calling it a coin-flip.
audit.why: The packet levelChart and the audited mirror both give Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen / Skill / Skill / Zaahen / Skill. Lucian's only escape is a 16s dash and Zaahen outreaches his 500-range Q with an 850 pull.
audit.corrected: All six rows proposed as matched full+content pairs with ratings set to suit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tells you to 'commit on Relentless Pursuit's cooldown' without ever saying how long it is, or that its length is not fixed.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14 — one of the longest escape dashes in the game — but Riot's text adds that 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown'. So the window you are waiting for shortens every time he lands a double-shot on you or the wave. Denying his autos is what keeps the dash down.
audit.corrected: The 16s figure and the auto-shortening rule now drive tldr, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[0].text, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the interaction that most directly punishes Zaahen's own kit: immobilising Lucian empowers Lightslinger. Zaahen's Q recast knock-up and his W pull both immobilise.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally, or when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage.' Landing your displacement therefore hands him two empowered shots — it is still worth landing, but the trade maths change and the page presents the pull as pure upside. His R is also a projectile, so line of sight cuts it.
audit.corrected: Written into dontsFull[1].d, and the projectile behaviour of The Culling into spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff is 'FAV' and the win rate is 52.81% over 2833 games, but diffRating read 8.5/10, the tone was the red token and report[14] called it a 'Hard matchup'.
audit.why: The page contradicted itself on the single most visible number.
audit.corrected: diffRating to 5.5/10, tone to the amber token, breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t rewritten to match.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Relentless Pursuit and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5.5/10. The lane is decided by whether you commit inside the 16s Relentless Pursuit window.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Even matchup — difficulty 5.5/10, Lucian carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: He kites you out — survive, then play the new-champ lane safe and combo the Relentless Pursuit gap. Zaahen wins the Relentless Pursuit cooldown windows.
edits.after: He kites, but Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and that is the whole lane: step up the moment he spends it. Zaahen wins those windows.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, but every Lightslinger double-shot shortens it — deny his autos and the dash stays gone. - Ardent Blaze (14s) marks you and speeds him up. - The Culling: 110s, and a projectile.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1, and his double-shots cut it — deny autos to keep it down.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Immobilising him powers his passive — your pull feeds his next shots.

edits.before: You own this window against a squishy lane-bully marksman. Lucian wants to Q Piercing Light and passive double-tap you through minions, but your Q Darkin Glaive out-ranges his poke setup and your E Golden Onslaught closes before he can E Relentless Pursuit away. Punish him the moment his dash is on cooldown — one connect from you chunks far more than his auto-poke.
edits.after: You own this window against a squishy marksman. Lucian pokes with Piercing Light at 500 range and the Lightslinger double-shot, but your 850 W pull outreaches that and your E closes before Relentless Pursuit can answer. Its 16s at rank 1 only shrinks when he lands autos — deny those, and one connect from you chunks far more than his poke.

edits.before: Lucian's R The Culling is a damage steroid, not an escape, so at 6 he's still yours if you have R Final Retribution up. His only safety is E, so bait it, then commit — this is an even beat only because his ult can burst you back if you engage low, so trade his cooldowns first.
edits.after: The Culling is a torrent of shots, not an escape, so at 6 he is still yours with your R banked — and it is a projectile, so terrain and line of sight cut it short. His only safety is E; bait it, then commit, and never engage low into a 110s ult you have not seen.

edits.before: Close with E Golden Onslaught the instant his E Relentless Pursuit is down
edits.after: Close with your E dash the instant Relentless Pursuit is spent, 16s gone

edits.before: Hold E Relentless Pursuit to dodge your engage and reset spacing
edits.after: Land double-shots to cut Relentless Pursuit under its 16s timer

notes: The kit file flags Lucian's passive with 'heal' and the repo's missing-interactions raises a needs-antiheal rule from it. Riot's own description of Lightslinger contains no healing — it triggers WHEN Lucian is healed or shielded by an ally. Per the rule that the description beats a derived flag, I did not write any anti-heal advice into this matchup and am recording the misfire here. Zaahen's ability names remain unverifiable from his kit file, so slot letters are used instead of the content layer's 'Darkin Glaive' / 'Golden Onslaught' / 'Final Retribution'.
